{{Top|leg}}
A '''Thaereian customs ship''' was a model of [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a Thaereian customs [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was used by the [[Cularin Militia|Cularin Armed Forces]] to defend the [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]], in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. Circa [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] boarded the customs ship and [[Death/Legends|killed]] all of the crew, replacing them with two [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] and two [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] that were loyal to him. Under Ezzar's command, the customs ship subsequently flew into the Almas [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and participated in an [[Destruction of the Almas Academy|attack]] on the [[Almas Academy]], a [[Jedi academy]] that was situated on the world.
